tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/async-runtime.md <<'EOF'
# Async runtime

The project's current recorded decision is to use tokio as its async runtime, chosen because it has the better ecosystem.
EOF
cat docs/policies/async-runtime.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/async-runtime.md`. It says the current recorded decision is to use tokio as the async runtime, because it has the better ecosystem.

The project's records hold two decisions on this subject. The earlier one (#19) chose async-std. The later one (#21, the user's "Actually tokio has a better ecosystem") switched to tokio, so I recorded tokio and left the retired runtime out of the file.

Record #21 isn't explicitly marked as replacing #19 in the catalog. I treated it as the current decision because it is later, comes from the same subject, and is worded as a switch.

I also had to write the file with the Write tool. My first attempt through the shell failed with a parser error.
